power-series.def: A series of the form $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n (x - a)^n$, centered at $x = a$; its sum is a function of $x$ wherever it converges.

radius-of-convergence.def: The number $R$ such that a power series centered at $a$ converges when $|x - a| < R$ and diverges when $|x - a| > R$; found with the ratio test.

interval-of-convergence.def: Every $x$ where a power series converges: the open interval from the radius, plus each endpoint where the series converges when tested on its own.
